notes: Fixed candidate family only; no parameter search.
The bands are configuration, not an executable recommendation.
All fills are touch/queue-aware/trade-through shadow estimates.
Inventory, orders, cost basis, realized PnL and round trips are token-scoped; station-day remains only a correlated risk/statistics cluster.
The $200 station-day cap uses cumulative_buy_cost: an exit releases current exposure but does not replenish that day's cumulative buy allowance.
